validity.summary: Row's existence, corridor, and most data points are strongly and specifically corroborated (4+ independent sources name 'Грязовец – Ленинград I'/'1 нитка' by exact segment name -- a genuine, well-documented Soviet-era trunk line, not a phantom or duplicate). The one open question is the recorded dual Operator value: current-operator evidence found (Gazprom branch page, independent contractor record, independent incident news -- 3 sources) supports ONLY Gazprom Transgaz Saint-Petersburg LLC as the present-day operator, including on a Vologda Oblast section of the line; no source found describes Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta LLC as a CURRENT operator -- every Ukhta-linked source describes only the 1975-79 HISTORICAL construction (by Ukhta's predecessor 'Севергазпром').

One source (Severgazprom newsletter, Aug 2017, p.3) describes the gas carried as coming from 'северных месторождений' ('northern fields') in the 1979 commissioning sentence, but this is too generic/unnamed to stage as a specific FuelSource value -- it names no field. Geographically the line is the southern extension of the Komi-Republic Punga-Vuktyl-Ukhta-Gryazovets corridor (per the same newsletter's own corporate history, referencing 'Пунга – Ухта – Грязовец' as the preceding trunk segment), so Western-Siberian/Komi-Republic-region gas fields (Vuktyl etc.) are the plausible ultimate source, but no source states this explicitly for THIS specific line/segment -- declining to stage an inferred field name as if sourced.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Status=operating confirmed. Evidence dated up to Nov 2024 shows the line remains an actively managed operating asset with no indication anywhere (Gazprom corporate pages, government decree, independent contractor records, regional press) of dormancy, decommissioning, or replacement. IMPORTANT DISTINCTION for this annual-update pass: this line (Gryazovets-Leningrad I, segment feeding domestic Vologda Oblast/Leningrad Oblast gas supply per 47news.ru's explicit 'питает... восток и север Ленобласти') is NOT part of Russia's export-pipeline network and is NOT the same corridor as the separate Gryazovets-Vyborg line that feeds the Nord Stream export system -- no geopolitical export-disruption caveat applies to this row. Active repair/reconstruction investment found spanning 2008-2009 (bt-svap.ru Sheksna-river section replacement; acs-service.ru 61-85km diagnostic survey) through at least Nov 2024 (kolpinscoe branch listing) is itself consistent with continuous operation, not a line approaching end-of-life.

summary: P5534 Gryazovets-Leningrad I: genuine, well-corroborated Soviet-era trunk line (4+ independent sources name segment I by exact name) -- confirmed operating (2024 evidence), 1975 construction/1979 start (Severgazprom corp history), 9.70 bcm/y capacity (govt decree), 1020mm diameter (2 independent sources), Vologda Oblast start + Leningrad Oblast end filled with refs, Gazprom PJSC owner reconfirmed. One attribution concern: Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta LLC's half of the recorded dual-Operator value has only historical-construction support, not current-operator evidence (Saint-Petersburg LLC is well-sourced as current operator). UNRESOLVED (searched, not found): Proposal, Pressure, Length (609km), FuelSource, SegmentCost. 2 cross-row leads filed for P5535 (1991 StartYear; possible Ду1200/1020mm diameter discrepancy).
